sentences.en: I got a video cassette recorder cheap at that shop.
sentences.zh: 我在那家店以便宜的价格买了一台盒式录音带录像机。

sentences.en: I had to pay ten dollars for the cassette in addition.
sentences.zh: 我还得另外付十美元买这个盒式录音带。

sentences.en: I had lost my purse, so I couldn't buy the cassette.
sentences.zh: 我丢了钱包，所以买不了那个盒式录音带了。

senses.zh: 盒式录音带,摄影胶卷暗匣，弹夹,珠宝箱，宝匣
